text.approach: From Marblemount on WA-20, drive the Cascade River Road (FR-15) about 19-21 miles (paved to roughly mile 10, then gravel/washboard) to the Eldorado trailhead (~2,150 ft). Cross the North Fork Cascade River and follow the unmaintained Eldorado climbers' trail through forest and a boulder field to treeline, then to Eldorado Basin/Roush Creek camps (~6,000-6,300 ft). Ascend the Eldorado Glacier snow dome to the ~7,500-ft notch on Eldorado's lower East Ridge, traverse ~1.5 miles north across the upper Inspiration Glacier to Klawatti Col (7,800 ft), then continue easily to the nearby Klawatti-Austera Col (7,900 ft) to start the ridge.
text.road: {"name":"Cascade River Road (FR-15)","status":"Open (paved to ~mile 10, gravel/washboard beyond)","driveNote":"Narrow gravel road; no RVs or trailers over 22 ft; Eldorado trailhead near road mile 20-21","seasonalGate":"Typically snow-gated in winter; sometimes washes out and requires Forest Service repair"}
text.overview: A Class 3 scramble along Klawatti's north ridge from the Klawatti-Austera Col, working around a rock tower nicknamed 'The Smokestack' before finishing on the summit crest.
text.descent: Downclimb the ridge crest back around The Smokestack via its west-side gully, return to the Klawatti-Austera Col, then to Klawatti Col. From there re-cross the Inspiration Glacier to the notch on Eldorado's East Ridge, descend the Eldorado Glacier, and follow the climbers' trail to the trailhead.
